fit_note: Verified-principle notes distilled from interaction episodes and injected into later frozen-VLM planner prompts.
Reflections steer candidate choice and test-time weight updates, not notes injected into later episodes; closest experience-reuse card.
LLM-written PDDL is gated by a classical planner with failure feedback, but main contribution is hierarchy plus prompt optimization.
KV-cache management for retrieved embodied memory; serving-efficiency contribution, not a context-selection design.
Behavior-tree retries gated by VLM condition nodes; main contribution is MoA proxy answering for interactive planning.
Skill repository mined from annotated DROID videos, expanded on demand and retrieved to implement new skills for a planner.
LLM builds a scheduling graph for a deterministic solver and writes programs over pre-implemented skills; main claim is the solver and process tree.
Coding agent rewrites the controller code between trials from traces; policy code, not a harness around a fixed model, and no held-out search split.
A learned visual Critic keeps the VLA executing until completion, anomaly or stagnation fires, then wakes the VLM planner.
VLM-inferred safety rules are grounded into a barrier and enforced by a CBF filter on a nominal controller; a safety filter rather than a proposal gate.
